save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer, lr schedule, and loss scaler state to disk
load_model_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a local file or URL and restore optimizer and scheduler state
save_on_master_process: save a PyTorch checkpoint to disk only on the main process in distributed training
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint by restoring model, optimizer, and epoch state
save_checkpoint_with_finetune: save a model checkpoint using the FSDP save_checkpoint method when no loss scaler is available
